text:
Rina Patel: quick heads-up  launching an SI onramp clinic focused on marketplace listing readiness + a tiny cert ladder. aim: 4 SIs, one joint announcement, and a hardware validation slot. thoughts? :megaphone:
Oliver Hayes: love it. suggest we split into 2 tracks: "deployment readiness" and "customer enablement". deployment track = terraform quickstart + smoke harness; enablement = co-marketing assets + joint announcement checklist.
Samantha Lee: operational note: need a validator harness that checks model endpoint, sample inference, and billing tags. i'll prototype a lightweight harness that returns pass/fail + short logs.
Kai Nakamura: vendor racks available 2024-10-18..2024-10-24. can reserve a 4-hour window per SI for the infra validation. vendor requires signed AUP for recordings. pinged them for extended stderr redaction guidance.
vendor-nexus: NexusCloud: confirmed rack hold for above dates pending AUP. provide a signed AUP at least 5 business days before the window. recording opt-in allowed with redaction request.
Rina Patel: thanks. on announcements: propose a joint blog + social + product listing sync. marketing-bot, can you bake a checklist for compliant announcement copy (logo, trademark, partner quote, co-branded screenshot)?
marketing-bot: checklist created: 1) partner logo approval 2) 2-line partner quote 3) screenshot w/ no PII 4) listing metadata (pricing, SLA) 5) launch date confirmation. placing doc in partnerships/announcements/si-onramp/. link: https://drive.redwood.ai/si-onramp-announce-checklist
Oliver Hayes: for cert ladder, propose three micro-gates: foundation quiz (docs + 15q), deploy exercise (quickstart + smoke harness pass), and live troubleshooting capstone (30m proctored). each gate has clear pass thresholds.
Samantha Lee: capstone needs a simple scoring rubric: diagnostics (0-5), mitigation (0-5), communication (0-2). pass = 10+. i'll add the rubric to the harness output so mentors can grade quickly.
Kai Nakamura: scheduling detail: prefer back-to-back validation windows so SIs can run deploy -> capstone in same week. also recommend a mentor shadow day before capstone.
Rina Patel: action items: Samantha = validator harness + rubric v0, Oliver = cert ladder outline + gating rules, Kai = finalize rack booking + AUP template, marketing-bot = announcement checklist and co-marketing intake. target: ship pilot schedule + signups by Mon 2024-09-09 (1760000000).
Oliver Hayes: i'll also assemble a tiny trainer cheat-sheet (common fixes: OOM -> switch to smaller variant, auth 401 -> rotate key, kv-cache miss -> warm prefixes). will drop it in the drive.
Samantha Lee: noted. i'll ensure harness redacts IPs and truncates logs. if vendors can't record, we can capture the harness output + mentor notes for badge evidence.
Rina Patel: perfect. if anyone has partner questions or wants to be on the announcement coordinating thread DM me. planning readout Thu 10am PT — invite incoming. :calendar:
